references.text: Elasaph, son of Deuel, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Gad during the census.
Elasaph, son of Deuel, was the leader of the camp of Gad in the arrangement of the camps.
Elasaph, son of Deuel, brought his offering as the leader of the tribe of Gad at the dedication of the altar.
The sons of Gad are mentioned as one of the tribes of Israel that went down to Egypt.
The tribe of Gad was mustered and numbered at 45,650 men.
